transport: MCP Streamable HTTP via authenticated parent gateway (future runtime)
status: contract-and-Neon-schema-implemented; no live MCP listener deployed
memory: Neon evidence and Cloudflare per-agent state remain authoritative

security.ingress: authenticated operator/service; strip untrusted caller seat headers
security.discovery: tools and resources filtered by server-trusted actor, mission, charter and ticket
security.operation: owning office authorizes at callee; cards never confer authority
security.writes: proposal only; trusted service fixes review_state='proposed', no end-user SQL
security.approvals: read-only approval references; execution and stamp validation are separate protected functions
security.defaults: no anonymous tools, no general SQL, no full-mesh discovery, no arbitrary execution

tools.name: catalog.card.get
tools.title: Read one versioned contextual card
tools.description: Use it for examining exact versioned index cards, their recorded content, original provenance, and revision-specific contextual meaning. Read-only.

tools.name: catalog.configuration.resolve
tools.title: Resolve an exact versioned card configuration
tools.description: Use it for assembling contextual perspectives from pinned index card revisions, tracing their membership in a specific configuration. Read-only.

tools.name: catalog.card.propose
tools.title: Propose a new inert card revision
tools.description: Use it for proposing a new, explicitly provisional index card revision and source context. Never grants approval, executes operations, or validates truth.

tools.name: evidence.node.get
tools.title: Read one evidence node
tools.description: Use it for examining a particular evidence-network node, sourced concept, observation, or claim in its own contextual record. Read-only.

tools.name: evidence.edge.trace
tools.title: Read proposed evidence relations and sources for one node
tools.description: Use it for relating evidence-network nodes, tracing directed semantic relationships and source-backed lexical links, and investigating conceptual connections. Read-only.

tools.name: evidence.edge.propose
tools.title: Propose source-attributed evidence relation without promotion
tools.description: Use it for proposing and attributing a provisional evidence-network relationship. It never proves a claim or grants an action.

tools.name: dictionary.lexical_path
tools.title: Read a pre-admitted WordNet sense and its recorded hypernym path
tools.guard: trusted Echo runtime must enforce Lobby-admitted word before invocation
tools.description: Dictionary — Contextual Understanding Resource. Purpose: continuous development, expansion, and refinement of contextual understanding. Use it for gaining additional meaning, expanding vocabulary, distinguishing lexical senses, grounding concepts, and building semantic relationships through definitions and hypernym pathways. Admitted words only; read-only; no automatic vocabulary admission.

tools.name: dictionary.network.compare
tools.title: Preview sourced lexical relation paths without admission
tools.guard: both words must already be admitted; results remain provisional
tools.description: Dictionary + Evidence Networking — Contextual Understanding Resource. Use it for relating existing vocabulary, exploring source-linked concept connections, grounding a lexical comparison in dictionary senses and evidence-network pathways, and distinguishing provisional associations from verified facts. Admitted words only; read-only; no automatic admission.

purpose: Tools advertise their positive contextual contributions; selection is based on capability descriptions and verified outcomes, not only missing-knowledge triggers.
comprehension_claim: Tool invocation alone does not prove contextual understanding; test outcome-based functional competence separately.
